findings.title: Live payment API key hardcoded in source
SQL injection: email interpolated into query via f-string
findings.evidence: query = f"SELECT id, name, email FROM customers WHERE email = '{email}'"

findings.title: Path traversal / arbitrary .csv file read: user-controlled filename joined to export dir without containment (absolute path or ../ overrides EXPORT_DIR)
Mutable default argument; the shared list is also aliased as invoice.items and then appended to, so line items leak across calls
Blanket except swallows every error and returns None; callers cannot distinguish failure causes and nothing is logged

No idempotency key and no locking: concurrent or retried requests can charge the same unbilled orders twice, and a failure in mark_billed after a successful charge leaves customer charged but orders unbilled
N+1 queries: one order_items query per order inside a loop; a single JOIN would do
Leftover debug print in request handler; bypasses logging and dumps invoice data to stdout
File opened without explicit encoding; output depends on locale
